hook: The exoplanet TOI-1355 b stops crossing its host star, blocking its light, in 7 years.

sections.voiceover: The exoplanet TOI-1355 b stops crossing its host star, blocking its light, in 7 years.
sections.visual_cue: Cinematic rendering of exoplanet TOI-1355 b orbiting close to a brilliant Main Sequence star, casting a sharp transit shadow.
sections.sfx_cue: Low deep space drone with subtle ticking clock resonance.
b_roll: NASA deep space animation of orbiting exoplanet
sections.animation_cue: Slow push-in on glowing planetary silhouette

sections.voiceover: On November 5, 2026, the NASA Exoplanet Archive cataloged 13 new planets. Why will its transit window close in 7 years?
sections.visual_cue: 3D astronomical map visualizing 13 newly discovered planet orbits across 11 star systems, highlighting TOI-1355 b.
sections.animation_cue: Animated callout markers appearing on 11 stellar systems

sections.voiceover: NASA confirms TOI-1355 b transits, where the planet passes in front of its star, vanish soon.
sections.visual_cue: Orbital mechanics diagram illustrating planetary precession shifting TOI-1355 b out of line-of-sight view from Earth.
b_roll: Space telescope camera aperture closing view
sections.animation_cue: Red trajectory arc shifting out of sight line

sections.voiceover: Scientists have only 7 years left to observe the transits of this specific planet.
